studentFacingBehavior: Question scoring remains unchanged until individual layout extensions are tested; no review or answer bank linked in public UI.

layouts.name: Picture answer cards
layouts.spec: Image tiles share aspect ratio; card captions and optional textual context separate from asset; no answer-specific border until feedback.

layouts.name: Picture + multiple correct choices
layouts.spec: Large context photo or scene and tap-friendly checklist; multiple selections with no immediate key in test mode.

layouts.name: Image-supported sentence completion
layouts.spec: Readable narrative above labelled dropdown fields; optional paired photo or illustration; no awkward inline tiny controls.

layouts.name: Drag terms to a labelled diagram
layouts.spec: Raster scene with labelled drop targets as independent, accessible HTML controls; keyboard choose-then-place fallback.

layouts.name: Sort image or text cards into visual destinations
layouts.spec: Drop zones may use images; clear unused bank; tested with pointer, touch, mouse and keyboard.

layouts.name: Complete energy/resource flowchart
layouts.spec: A reusable flowchart renderer with neutral boxes and directional connections; drop zone contents are not baked into the image.

layouts.name: Match photo, term and definition
layouts.spec: Term board, illustrated bank and definition destinations; support many-to-one only if scoring explicitly permits.

layouts.name: Compare two scenes
layouts.spec: Before/after imagery shares camera perspective; only code provides precise before/after readings or measurements.

layouts.name: Investigation setup + reasoning
layouts.spec: Two-column desktop, stacked phone: original investigation photo, evidence notes, and response; educational context before controls.

layouts.name: Choose the strongest evidence
layouts.spec: Readable source excerpt and selectable statement lines, optionally paired with authentic-type context art; not automatically a photo click-map.

layouts.name: Sequence stages with visual cues
layouts.spec: Move-up/down controls plus optional illustrative scene without showing ordering through filenames or panel numbering.

layouts.name: Data table or scale + numerical response
layouts.spec: Coded axes/labels/numeric ticks ensure quantitative truth; photo backgrounds only for context.

layouts.name: Tap a precise location in a photo
layouts.spec: Currently not an engine feature. Prototype explicit accessible region controls and validate hit targets before using scored image coordinates.
